frontMatter.yaml:
# Model-based-testing variant of the fair task queue model (see ../m5.fizz).
#
# This spec drives the REAL fairTaskReader/fairTaskWriter through a test
# adapter (service/matching/fizz_mbt_*_test.go), so its actions are collapsed
# to the points where the adapter can actually pause the code: persistence
# calls parked in a gating TaskManager wrapper, task completion, and task
# expiry. Between actions the SUT is quiescent (all goroutines parked at the
# gate or idle), and every state variable below is read directly from the
# SUT for comparison after every action.
#
# Differences from m5 (model-checking variant):
#  - The read loop is collapsed: "pending read request" (read_from/read_batch
#    != -1) corresponds to a real GetTasks call parked at the gate. Issuing a
#    read (maybeReadTasksLocked -> readTasksImpl -> GetFairTasks) happens
#    inside other actions; DbReadOk both merges the response and runs the
#    loop continuation (next read / exit + newlyWrittenTasks + re-check).
#  - The writer is collapsed to WriterWrite (pin + pick level + park at
#    CreateTasks) and WriterWriteOk/WriterWriteTimeout (release the parked
#    call; merge-or-buffer + unpin happen synchronously in the SUT before it
#    quiesces, so they are part of the same spec action).
#  - No read timeouts / backoff timer (the real timer is wall-clock and the
#    adapter cannot interleave it deterministically) and no GC (not modeled,
#    see ../m5.fizz).
#  - No liveness (MBT checks trace conformance, not liveness).
options:
  max_actions: 100
  max_concurrent_actions: 2
  crash_on_yield: false
deadlock_detection: false
